_comment: Allowlist for scripts/run_job.py. Only jobs listed here can be started by the lead without asking. Each job must be resumable (checkpointed), write only to data/processed/ or feature folders, never delete raw data, and finish within max_hours. Adding an entry follows the rules in docs/agent-team/STANDING_ORDERS.md.

fno_features.description: Stage 10 F&O feature block, full history (recomputes everything)

verify_stage10_fno_features.description: Stage 10 F&O feature verifier on the full-history output

publication_monitor.description: Publication-timing monitor for TODAY (IST) as target date; start it BEFORE the evening publications, once per trading day (user item 20, 2026-10-30). Writes data/raw/_publication/first_seen.jsonl only at its end; not resumable.

m1_h5_zero.description: Stage 13M M1 run, horizon 5, impact 0 (writes data/processed/m1/, resumable, run the four m1 jobs one at a time: they share cache files)

m1_h5_floor.description: Stage 13M M1 run, horizon 5, pessimistic impact floor (judged run)

m1_h20_floor.description: Stage 13M M1 run, horizon 20, pessimistic impact floor (judged run)

m1b_h5_zero.description: Stage 13M M1b run (corrected M1), horizon 5, impact 0. Writes data/processed/m1b/, resumable; run the m1b jobs one at a time, zero before floor (labels are shared)

m1b_h5_floor.description: Stage 13M M1b run, horizon 5, pessimistic impact floor (judged run)

m1b_h20_floor.description: Stage 13M M1b run, horizon 20, pessimistic impact floor (judged run)

m1b_cliff0_h5_floor.description: M1b diagnostic (NOT JUDGED): liquidity cliff off so the 0.20% tier is exercised, h=5, floor. Own directory data/processed/m1b_cliff0/

m1b_cliff0_h20_floor.description: M1b diagnostic (NOT JUDGED): liquidity cliff off, h=20, floor. Own directory data/processed/m1b_cliff0/

announcements_full.description: Stage 16 NSE corporate announcements, full history 2003-01-01 to yesterday (one monthly request per chunk, resumable: a chunk is done when its Parquet exists). Writes ONLY data/raw/announcements/ and data/raw/_manifests/announcements.jsonl. One-off exception to standing orders s5, approved by the user 2026-10-31.

announcements_reresolve.description: Row 16: re-resolve already-saved announcement files through the point-in-time ISIN bridge (no network; only unresolved symbol_not_in_master / symbol_outside_traded_window rows with an ISIN; atomic, resumable, idempotent). Builds the symbol master first (~2.5 min). Never run alongside an M3 job.

verify_stage16_announcements.description: Stage 16 announcements verifier (per-year counts, bridged and unresolved-by-reason counts, independent PIT check of bridged records).

baselines_tune_h5.description: Stage 14 B1 hyperparameter tuning on fold 0's inner split only, h=5. Prints/writes data/processed/baselines/b1_tuned_h5.json; the lead copies it into vanta.baselines and commits BEFORE the b1 job. Not checkpointed (single pass, rerun from start). User-directed 2026-11-01.

baselines_tune_h20.description: Stage 14 B1 hyperparameter tuning on fold 0's inner split only, h=20 (see baselines_tune_h5).

baselines_a0_h5.description: Stage 14 A0 (12-1 momentum) walk-forward OOS, h=5. Writes data/processed/baselines/. Not checkpointed. User-directed 2026-11-01.

baselines_a1_h5.description: Stage 14 A1 (XGBoost + deterministic scorer feature) walk-forward OOS, h=5. Not part of M2 judging.

baselines_a1_h20.description: Stage 14 A1 walk-forward OOS, h=20. Not part of M2 judging.

baselines_b1_h5.description: Stage 14 B1 (CatBoost, 5 seeds) walk-forward OOS, h=5. Refuses to run with untuned placeholder params: run baselines_tune_h5 and commit the tuned dict first.

baselines_b1_h20.description: Stage 14 B1 walk-forward OOS, h=20 (see baselines_b1_h5).

baselines_a0_h60.description: Stage 14 A0 at h=60: DIAGNOSTIC horizon (M2_PREREG s9.2b), not judged. Builds the h=60 NEL label cache (long).

baselines_b1_h60.description: Stage 14 B1 at h=60: DIAGNOSTIC horizon, not judged; reuses the h=20 tuned parameters.

m2_h5_floor_atr.description: M2 judged cell: h=5, pessimistic floor, ATR k=1.5 levels. Writes data/processed/m2/; skips finished cells.

m2_h5_zero_atr.description: M2 reported cell: h=5, impact zero, ATR.

m2_h20_floor_atr.description: M2 judged cell: h=20, pessimistic floor, ATR.

m2_h20_zero_atr.description: M2 reported cell: h=20, impact zero, ATR.

m2_h5_floor_hold.description: M2 DIAGNOSTIC (NOT JUDGED): A11 hold-to-horizon, h=5, floor.

m2_h20_floor_hold.description: M2 DIAGNOSTIC (NOT JUDGED): A11 hold-to-horizon, h=20, floor.

m2_h60_floor_hold.description: M2 DIAGNOSTIC (NOT JUDGED): A11 hold-to-horizon, h=60, floor.

m2_h60_floor_atr.description: M2 DIAGNOSTIC (NOT JUDGED): h=60 with ATR levels, floor.

m2_report.description: Assemble logs/m2_report.md from the saved M2 cells (runs the invariant suite for criterion 1).

m3_tune_h5.description: M3 B1 tuning on hold-to-horizon labels, fold 0 inner split only, h=5. Writes data/processed/m3/b1hold_tuned_h5.json; the lead pastes it into vanta.m3.B1_HOLD_PARAMS_BY_HORIZON and commits BEFORE the score job. Owner 2026-11-02.

m3_tune_h20.description: M3 B1 tuning on hold-to-horizon labels, fold 0 inner split only, h=20.

m3_tune_h60.description: M3 B1 tuning on hold-to-horizon labels, fold 0 inner split only, h=60 (own tuning, not reusing h=20).

m3_score_h5.description: M3 B1 walk-forward OOS scoring on hold labels, h=5 (reported, not judged). Refuses while the horizon's params are the placeholder.

m3_score_h20.description: M3 B1 walk-forward OOS scoring on hold labels, h=20 (judged).

m3_score_h60.description: M3 B1 walk-forward OOS scoring on hold labels, h=60 (judged).

m3_h5_floor.description: M3 gate cell, h=5, floor (reported, NOT JUDGED).

m3_h5_zero.description: M3 gate cell, h=5, zero impact (reported, NOT JUDGED).

m3_h20_zero.description: M3 gate cell, h=20, zero impact (reported, NOT JUDGED).

m3_h60_zero.description: M3 gate cell, h=60, zero impact (reported, NOT JUDGED).

m3_report.description: Assemble logs/m3_report.md from the saved M3 cells (runs the invariant suite for criterion 1).

paper_log_weekly.description: Forward paper log (row 19): append the latest decision week's B1 hold-to-horizon candidates and the three arms' publications (h=20, h=60) to the append-only files under data/processed/paper_log/; fills matured outcomes in a separate append-only file. Resumable, idempotent; refuses if input data is stale. Writes only data/processed/paper_log/ and models/. Run Sunday or Monday before the open. Owner 2026-11-02.

refresh_bhavcopy.description: Row 20 catch-up (owner 2026-11-10): equity bhavcopy to the latest day via the existing ingester (weekday + weekends pass). Skips dates already on disk; deletes nothing; writes data/raw only. RAM gate 2 GB.

refresh_bhavdata.description: Row 20 catch-up: sec_bhavdata_full (delivery) to the latest day. Same rules as refresh_bhavcopy.

refresh_fno_bhavcopy.description: Row 20 catch-up: F&O bhavcopy to the latest day. Same rules as refresh_bhavcopy.

refresh_fno_ban.description: Row 20 catch-up: F&O ban lists to the latest day. Same rules as refresh_bhavcopy.

refresh_sec_list.description: Row 20 catch-up: sec_list (circuit bands; needed by the circuits block) to the latest day. Same rules as refresh_bhavcopy.

refresh_price_band_hits.description: Row 20 catch-up: price-band hit lists to the latest day. Same rules as refresh_bhavcopy.

refresh_indices.description: Row 20 catch-up: index files (incl. India VIX) to the latest day. Same rules as refresh_bhavcopy.

refresh_fii_dii.description: Row 20 catch-up: FII/DII forward capture (latest day only; past days cannot be backfilled and stay NaN + flagged).

refresh_announcements.description: Row 20 catch-up: corporate announcements to the latest day (existing ingester; ISIN-bridge re-resolve is a separate existing job and is not run here). Same rules as refresh_bhavcopy.
